phase_name: Mutation check and full regression sweep

objectives.description: Full mutation cycle: revert fix, confirm RED, restore, confirm GREEN
Record and cross-check mutation RED set against Phase 2 RED set
Narrower mutation: comment-strip clause only, confirm exactly the #-comment case goes red
Restore full fix, repo-wide run-all.sh sweep
Confirm file left in fixed state, no leftover stash/backup

notes: Mutation 1 (full revert, via cp swap against a scratch copy read from the pre-fix git commit -- no git stash/checkout/reset touched the tracked file): 32 passed / 11 failed. The 11 FAIL labels are byte-for-byte identical to the Phase 2 recorded RED set. No drift.

Mutation 2 (comment-strip clause removed only, quote-strip kept): 42 passed / 1 failed. The single failure is 'defect: #-comment --staged does not exempt a real restore', confirming that clause is independently load-bearing.
Restored fix verified byte-identical to the committed Phase 3/4 version (diff against a pre-mutation scratch copy: no output; git status --short on the hook: no diff).

Repo-wide run-all.sh sweep after restoring the fix: 42 passed, 1 failed, 0 skipped, 43 total (suite-level). The one failing suite, test-validate-return-meta.sh, is pre-existing and unrelated to this task's file scope; it also failed (with a different internal case count, 41/2 vs this run's 42/1 at the run-all summary level) on the pre-Phase-6 baseline run in Phase 5, before any Phase 6 mutation testing began -- a pre-existing flake, not a regression introduced by this task.
git stash list unchanged across this phase (still only the two pre-existing entries from other concurrent agents' operations).
